subject: runtime/periodic-freshness
statement: Periodic runtime freshness is opt-in for existing projects and configured as runtimeUpdate.mode off|notify|auto with a TTL. Missing or invalid config fails soft to off. Existing consumer projects remain off unless configured; newly generated bootstrap/preset configs default to notify, while the Agent DevTools source repository explicitly dogfoods auto. Checks run only on begin/doctor, use local .agent-cache state, never require a daemon, and network/update or cache-write failures never block routine work.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Add TTL-based periodic runtime freshness with off, notify, and auto modes without daemons or routine network calls
